chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"A believer alone is a proof, and a believer alone is a congregation."

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet, the one conveying this teaching
key_terms.اَلْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer, one characterized by iman

ai.seo_question: How can one believer alone be considered a proof and a congregation in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a true believer possesses evidentiary and communal weight even when alone. In the context of congregational prayer, it highlights the dignity, standing, and religious significance of the believer.
